noTenantAccess: This account has no tenant access yet. Ask an administrator to add you to a tenant.
serverUnreachable: Could not reach the server. Check that the API is running.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
sessionSsoRequired: Your organization now requires single sign-on for this tenant, so your password session has ended. Use Sign in with SSO.
signInSubtitle: Sign in to the management console
signInUnavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
signOutFailed: You were signed out on this device, but the server could not end the session. If this is a shared computer, sign in and out again.
ssoEmailRequired: Enter your email address first, then choose Sign in with SSO.
ssoErrorGroupsOverage: Your identity provider reported more group memberships than it can include in a sign-in. Ask your administrator to narrow the groups that are sent.
ssoErrorIdp: Your identity provider could not complete the sign-in. Try again, or contact your administrator.
ssoErrorLinkRequired: Your account exists but is not linked to this identity provider yet. Ask your administrator to approve the link, or sign in another way.
ssoErrorMissingCode: The sign-in did not return the information needed to finish. Start again from the sign-in page.
ssoErrorMissingVerifier: This sign-in was not started in this browser tab, or its record is gone. Start again from the sign-in page.
ssoErrorRedeemFailed: The sign-in could not be completed. It may have expired or already been used. Start again from the sign-in page.
ssoErrorRefused: Single sign-on did not allow this account in. Contact your administrator if you expected access.
ssoNotConfigured: Single sign-on is not set up for that email address. Sign in with your password.
ssoRequired: Your organization requires single sign-on. Use Sign in with SSO instead of a password.
ssoUnavailable: Single sign-on is not available right now.
tooManyAttempts: Too many failed sign-in attempts for this account. Wait a moment, then try again.
